ListSandboxesV2ByPath.limit: Number of items per page, default 100; values less than 1, greater than 100, or non-numeric are treated as 100.
ListSandboxesV2ByPath.nextToken: Pagination cursor; use the X-Next-Token value from the previous page's response header; omit for the first page.
ListSandboxesV2ByPath.metadata: Metadata filter condition, formatted as URL-encoded key=value&key2=value2, with multiple conditions joined by AND.
ListSandboxesV2ByPath.state: State filter; options are running and paused; can be passed repeatedly (state=running&state=paused) or comma-separated (state=running,paused); defaults to both running and paused if omitted.
